meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 HyperFrames 命令行来创建、检查、预览和渲染视频项目。它会先运行检查,再打开预览,必须等到你批准后才输出成片,也能用来排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你说要创建或编辑视频项目、排查构建或渲染失败,或要求预览/渲染视频时。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 帮我新建一个视频项目
say.note: 会运行 init 创建项目结构。

say.text: 帮我对这个项目做最终检查
say.note: 会运行 check 并报告问题。

say.text: 先预览,我确认后再渲染
say.note: 会打开预览并等待你的批准。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use HyperFrames CLI to scaffold, check, preview, and render video projects. It runs checks, opens a preview, and waits for your approval before rendering. It also helps diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or edit a video project, diagnose build/render failures, or request preview/render.

say_en.text: Use HyperFrames to create a new video project.
say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Run the final check on this project.
say_en.note: Runs check and reports any issues.

say_en.text: Preview first, then render after I approve.
say_en.note: Opens preview and waits for approval.
